records.notes: Whole 4-stroke Vivasam sequence, cumulative paths and final glyph reviewed. Stroke 1 inks right-to-left: reverse only source stroke 1. Stroke 2 descends then turns right. At 4.3-4.5 s the guide dot moves upward without new ink; at 4.6-5.1 s stroke 3 accumulates top-to-bottom. The previous bottom-to-top claim confused repositioning with inking and is superseded. Stroke 4 descends, curves right at the bottom and hooks upward. Naver/e-hanja chronological strokes 1 and 3 corroborate these directions. Exact whole-glyph evidence, not radical inference. Evidence: docs/hanja-g3-direction-2026-09-15/. Times are sampled completed-by observations, not exact pen lifts. Only this whole-glyph comparison authorizes this entry.
